title: Enterprise Multi-Model Router (RouteLLM Matrix Factorization), Logprob-Margin Abstention Cascade & Cost-Quality Pareto

tiers.tier: Tier 1: 100% Frontier Model Default Routing (No Router or Cascade)
tiers.architecture: Sending 100% of enterprise queries directly to a frontier 70B/671B/Sonnet model regardless of prompt difficulty

tiers.tier: Tier 2: Prompt-Length / Regex Heuristic Router + Uncalibrated SLM Self-Ask
tiers.architecture: Routing prompts < 500 tokens to an 8B SLM and asking the 8B model 'Are you confident? (Yes/No)' in text

tiers.tier: Tier 3: Standalone Embedding Cosine Router (`RouteLLM` Pre-Router Only, No Post-Verification)
tiers.architecture: Single-stage embedding classifier predicting win-rate pre-generation without first-token logprob margin abstention

tiers.tier: Tier 4: Matrix-Factorization Win-Rate Pre-Router + First-16-Token Logprob Margin Abstention Cascade
tiers.architecture: 8ms Bradley-Terry Matrix-Factorization Router (Prompt x Model Latent Space) + Early-Token Logprob Entropy/Margin Verifier + Speculative Escalation

scenarios.scenario: Short-But-Hard Reasoning Trap ('2-Sentence Olympiad / SQL Subtle Join Bug')
scenarios.question: User submits a 45-token SQL query asking why a LEFT JOIN with a WHERE filter silently drops NULL rows
scenarios.model_answer: Bradley-Terry Matrix-Factorization router projects prompt embedding v_q against model capability vectors v_m -> detects high reasoning difficulty despite short length (P_win(8B) = 0.18 < tau) and routes directly to 70B/R1 (0.3% under-routing)
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 2 heuristic router sees 45 tokens (< 500 limit) and sends to 8B SLM, which verbalizes 'Confidence: 95%' while giving a wrong answer (21.8% silent hallucination).

scenarios.scenario: Long-But-Easy Extraction Task ('16K Meeting Transcript Action-Item Bulleting')
scenarios.question: User submits a 16,000-token meeting transcript asking to extract explicit `{owner, due_date}` JSON items
scenarios.model_answer: Matrix-Factorization router scores P_win(8B_FP8) = 0.96 >= tau -> routes to 8B SLM with XGrammar schema constraint at 1/12th the cost of frontier model ($64K/mo total spend)
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 1 & Tier 2 length heuristics route all 16K-token prompts to the expensive frontier model, burning $240,000/mo.

scenarios.scenario: Catching Pre-Router False Negatives via First-16-Token Logprob Margin Abstention
scenarios.question: A domain-specific regulatory prompt passes the pre-router to the 8B SLM, but the 8B model encounters an unfamiliar statute citation during generation
scenarios.model_answer: Monitor top-1 vs. top-2 token log-probability margin Delta_logprob across the first 16 generated tokens; when mean(p_top1 - p_top2) < 0.35, abort 8B stream in <40ms before flushing to user and escalate to 70B frontier model (99.2% quality retention)
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 3 pre-router has no post-dispatch check—once routed to 8B, the user receives the hallucinated statute (7.4% under-routing error).

scenarios.scenario: Zero-Retraining New Model Onboarding via 200-Prompt Golden Anchor Probing
scenarios.question: Onboard a newly released model (`Qwen3-32B` or `Claude-4-Sonnet`) into the enterprise router without collecting 100,000 new pairwise human preference labels
scenarios.model_answer: Evaluate the new model offline on a fixed 200-prompt IRT (Item Response Theory) anchor battery to fit its 64-dim latent capability vector v_m_new while keeping the prompt projection network frozen
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Multi-class classifier routers require full end-to-end retraining every time a model is added or deprecated.

perturbation_checks.check: Out-of-Distribution (OOD) Proprietary Internal Acronym & Codebase Jargon
perturbation_checks.perturbed: 99.0% Quality Retention | 0.4% Under-Routing (First-16-Token Logprob Margin Escalates OOD Queries Automatically)

perturbation_checks.check: Dynamic FinOps Budget Slider Shift (End-of-Month Cost-Saving Mode)
perturbation_checks.perturbed: 15.0% Frontier Share | $51,000/Mo Spend (Adjusting Threshold tau Moves Smoothly Along Pareto Frontier Without Retraining)

key_findings: Tier 4 (8ms Bradley-Terry Matrix-Factorization Pre-Router + First-16-Token Logprob Margin Abstention Cascade) retains 99.2% of frontier-model quality while dispatching only 22.0% of requests to the frontier model, cutting monthly inference spend from $240K to $64K (-73.3%).

Prompt token length is negatively correlated with reasoning difficulty on many enterprise tasks (short SQL/math puzzles vs. long transcript extractions), causing length heuristics and verbalized SLM self-confidence to fail on 21.8% of hard queries.

Adding a first-16-token top-1/top-2 log-probability margin verifier catches out-of-distribution pre-router misses in <40ms before tokens are flushed to the user, slashing silent SLM hallucinations from 7.4% (pre-router only) to 0.3%.
